name: Zim's Bagging Company
old_description: Since 1964, Zim's Bagging Company has been converting and printing film, foam and bubble packaging materials. We differentiate ourselves from others in our industry by specializing in value-added, custom designed, non-standard packaging.
about:
Zim's Bagging Company was founded in 1964 in Prichard, West Virginia. The business began as a converter and printer of film, foam, and bubble packaging materials and has operated continuously from its West Virginia location for six decades.

The company runs two production sites—a Main Facility and a SoftPack Facility—equipped for forming, folding, cutting, and sealing plastic film, foam, and bubble roll stock into bags and pouches. Its capabilities include flexographic printing up to 10 colors on a 59-inch web using a W&H Miraflex II press, as well as simpler line printing. Custom features such as tapes, handles, wickets, punched holes, labels, and bar codes can be added, and the firm offers photo-quality front-and-back printing on roll stock for automated form-and-fill lines. Core product lines encompass poly bags, wicket bags, PowerPack Mailer Bags, printed roll stock, and foam and bubble products.

Zim's serves customers in automotive, e-commerce, food, home and garden, industrial, and medical markets, supplying custom packaging tailored to each sector's requirements.

The company emphasizes its focus on value-added, non-standard packaging designs, citing more than 55 years of experience in the flexible packaging industry as a key differentiator.
